newsitem.title: UK: UK govt did not campaign enough on economy - Clarke.
newsitem.headline: UK govt did not campaign enough on economy - Clarke.

text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke said on Friday the ruling Conservatives' election campaign did not focus hard enough on the economy.
"There was far too little about the economy. If we had less on Europe and a lot less on sleaze we might have done it," he told BBC telvision.
He was speaking as exit polls and early election results suggested opposition Labour would secure a landslide victory.
